package.name: san_costmap
package.description: SAN v1.3 PHASE 1 - 4-layer local cost map (obstacle / traversability / inflation) with v1.3 UGV thresholds: 235 mm lethal obstacle, 100 mm inflated; 30° lethal slope; 220 mm lethal ditch. Publishes CostMapUpdate at 10 Hz (1 Hz refresh). PNG-encoded grid via OpenCV.
